name: ASPEN COMMERCIAL SAUNA
description:
With an interior ceiling height of just under 6 feet, the 2019 Aspen commercial sauna is designed for standing and stretching with a hot yoga regimen. Floor to ceiling far infrared heater panels on back wall.

30 square feet of total heater panel coverage delivers maximum infrared exposure for optimum health benefits. Zero rated EMF Nano-Carbon™ Far Infrared Heater panels are the safest on the market with a 97% infrared efficiency. Slotted Flo-Thru Bench Seat. Ideal for Business or Home Setting.

Just plug it into a standard dedicated household 120 volt/20 amp wall outlet and have a wonderful sauna experience.

Featured Aspen Sauna shown in Hemlock wood.
